description.fallback: As the Ripple makes contact with Straizo's face, Joseph's punch sends the vampire flying off the side of the bridge. Straizo desperately attempts to latch on to a ledge and fails, but Joseph quickly grabs his arm and holds him in mid-air. Straizo asks why Joseph saved him despite his knowledge that he still has enough power to blow off Joseph's right arm.
